summary: Frontend-only re-test (iteration_82) of MikiLab after the ES crash fix. VERIFIED FIXED: tab 'Aprende' (nav-tab-impara) in Spanish no longer white-screens — renders full ES content (body ~5.2-5.3k chars: 'Para principiantes', 'Tu recorrido', 'Receta del día', 'Quiz del Panadero'), 0 page errors. Verified 5 recipe folders unchanged, all 5 new viennoiserie recipes show real Unsplash photos (HTTP 200, no grey placeholder), no croissant/cornetti/panettone/stollen leaked into 'Pane & Panificati', Recipe Generator works end-to-end (gen-result 4783 chars with computed doses + procedure). Impara loads without crash in IT/DE/EN/ES. NOT FIXED: the Enciclopedia section shown in the UI is still ITALIAN when lang=es (the ES fix was applied to src/data/content.js, but the visible page renders from src/sections/Enciclopedia.jsx + src/sections/GuidaMetodi.jsx, which have no 'es' blocks). Also ES avatar bubbles in Impara fall back to English.

ui_bugs.issue: ENC_ENTRIES only defines it/de/en; with lang=es the code falls back to ENC_ENTRIES.it so all encyclopedia entries render in ITALIAN in Spanish UI (header/subtitle are translated, body is not). Add an 'es' array.

All 4 method sections (Poolish, Lievito Madre pane vs panettone, Roggen Sauerteig, Backmittel) have it/de/en only (0 'es' blocks); `s[lang] || s.it` renders Italian text in Spanish. Confirmed on screen: 'Il poolish è un prefermento LIQUIDO...' with ES header 'Enciclopedia de mi pan'.
8 bubbles have 'en' but only 2 have 'es' -> in ES the Aprende header bubbles show ENGLISH text ("Learn calmly: here you'll find...", "Take the Baker's Quiz and track your progress...").
Clicking gen-submit with the empty 'PRODOTTO' field does nothing: no validation message, no disabled state, no toast (silent no-op). Add inline validation / disabled button.

issues: cat-folder-* headers expose only the emoji as first text line to a11y/testing tools (folder name is a background-image style title); recipe-row-* first text line is just the origin flag emoji — makes row identification fragile. Consider adding data-testid with slug or aria-label with the recipe name.

action_items: Add a complete 'es' block to ENC_ENTRIES in /app/frontend/src/sections/Enciclopedia.jsx (Italian is currently shown in ES).
Add 'es' translations for the 4 SECTIONS in /app/frontend/src/sections/GuidaMetodi.jsx.
Add missing 'es' strings to the 6 bubbles in /app/frontend/src/components/AvatarBubbles.jsx (currently English in ES).
Optional: add validation feedback when gen-submit is pressed with empty product field.
critical_code_review_comments: Two parallel encyclopedia data sources exist: content.js `encyclopedia` (src/sections/Encyclopedia.jsx) and ENC_ENTRIES/GuidaMetodi (src/sections/Enciclopedia.jsx). The ES fix was applied only to content.js, which is NOT what the Recetas->Enciclopedia entry point renders. Consolidate to a single source to avoid divergent translations.
Language fallback pattern `X[lang] || X.it` silently hides missing translations; consider a dev-time warning or a translation-coverage check.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 scenarios pass; Enciclopedia ES still Italian)

seed_data_creation: none (no test data created; login with existing admin@mikilab.de)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ES Impara crash is definitively fixed (0 pageerror, ES content rendered). Remaining work is pure i18n content: Enciclopedia.jsx ENC_ENTRIES + GuidaMetodi.jsx SECTIONS + AvatarBubbles.jsx need 'es'. Note DE/EN Enciclopedia label is 'Lexikon'/'Encyclopedia' — do not select by the Italian text. Recipe rows expose only flag emoji as first text line; use has_text with the recipe name. Generator requires the PRODOTTO input filled before gen-submit; AI response takes ~20-40s. Stripe checkout was NOT exercised (LIVE).
rca_of_the_issue: The remaining ES-Italian encyclopedia issue: the UI route Recetas -> Enciclopedia renders src/sections/Enciclopedia.jsx which builds its list from GuidaMetodi SECTIONS (`s[lang] || s.it`) plus ENC_ENTRIES[lang] || ENC_ENTRIES.it. Neither file has an 'es' key, so Italian is served. The es block added to src/data/content.js is consumed by a different (unused for this route) component, src/sections/Encyclopedia.jsx.
